description: This file declares functions and types related to hash lookup operations, including binary search in a sorted hash table, and functions for locating object IDs within a data structure.

methods.name: oid_pos
methods.description: Finds the position of a given object ID within a table by using a user-defined access function.

methods.name: bsearch_hash
methods.description: Performs a binary search for a hash in a table, using a fanout array for interval determination.

ctags.name: oid_access_fn
ctags.pattern: /^typedef const struct object_id *oid_access_fn(size_t index, const void *table);$/
ctags.typeref: typename:const struct object_id * ()(size_t index,const void * table)
